trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions. The service is now **healthy with a 0.2% error rate**.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0" — documenting the diagnosis, the partial rollback and retry, and the recovery. The on-call engineer was paged.

Follow-up: v2.3.1 should be root-caused before any redeploy attempt.
